newsitem.title: USA: Opinion Research adopts rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Opinion Research adopts rights plan.

text.p: Opinion Research Corp said Friday its board of directors had adopted a stockholder rights plan designed to protect stockholders from "potentially abusive takeover tactics".
But the company said the adoption of the plan was not in response to "any known efforts to acquire control" of it.
It said the plan was to assure that all of its stockholders received "fair and equal" treatment if a takeover were to occur.

Under the plan, the company said it would distribute one stock purchase right for each common share held as of October 3. Each right will entitle stockholders to purchase 1/1000th of a newly issued share of Series A Junior Participating Preferred Stock if a takeover attempt were to arise, it added.
In April, New York investment adviser Cumberland Associates rose its stake in the company to 13.6 percent or 455,000 shares.
